Validate PS2 controller mappings with the PCSX2 Pad Test

blocks.text: The current PCSX2 Qt and Big Picture interfaces do not provide an input tester, according to the controller guide. PCSX2 links a PS2 Pad Test homebrew application that displays DualShock 2 inputs. It can show whether an input reaches the emulated pad without depending on one game’s control scheme. Use only the file linked from official PCSX2 documentation; the procedure needs no commercial game data.

Keep your own lawful BIOS and game images separate; Pad Test is homebrew test software, not firmware or a game. Record the active input source, Port 1 bindings, and any game-specific profile. Close the game and observe the test result before changing mappings. Follow the official documentation link to its linked project release; avoid third-party bundles that add BIOS or commercial titles.

items: 1. Open the official PCSX2 controller documentation and follow its PS2 Pad Test link.
2. Obtain the test ELF from the linked project release. Do not use bundles that include firmware or commercial games.
3. Drag and drop the ELF onto PCSX2’s main window, or add it to a game-list folder and refresh the list.
4. Launch the test and note the on-screen input indicators.
5. Press one mapped face button, direction, shoulder button, and each analog stick separately; release each before testing another.
6. Test Port 2 only if the game setup requires a second pad and the test shows the corresponding port.

blocks.text: Pass when each tested physical control changes only its corresponding on-screen input and returns to neutral on release. A missing indicator points to host detection, source, or mapping. Correct indicators with failure in one game point instead to that game’s controller mode, profile, or control scheme. Record failed controls before changing configuration.

items: ELF will not boot: confirm it is the official linked test file and that PCSX2 can boot your lawful BIOS.
Controller is absent from settings: solve host device detection before editing PS2 bindings.
Indicator stays active after release: inspect duplicate or stuck bindings and retest with other input devices disconnected.
Test works but one title ignores input: check that title’s active profile and its in-game controller options.

blocks.text: Close the test and remove it from the game list if you added it only for diagnosis. Restore the recorded profile if you changed one. Keeping or deleting the homebrew test is a storage choice; it does not alter BIOS, game images, or memory-card saves.
